title: Frame AI — AI video editor: photo to video, subtitles
description: Frame AI: turn a photo into an 8-second video with sound, auto-edit clips into a reel, add voiceover and auto subtitles. A video editor for Android.
h1: Frame AI — an AI video editor for short videos
lead: What are we shooting today? Frame AI turns photos into video, edits reels from your clips automatically, voices your text and adds subtitles — all on your phone, no complex software.

p: Pick a photo and describe the motion in your own words, for example "she turns to the camera and smiles, wind in her hair". Frame AI creates an 8-second video with sound. There are ready prompts like "a light smile and a blink" or "slow camera zoom", and the free Text help button turns a couple of words into a precise prompt.
Choose vertical 9:16 for social media or horizontal 16:9 for YouTube, and Fast (720p) or Quality (1080p) mode. Generation uses in-app credits. To create the video, the photo is sent to Google.

sections.h2: Auto-edit in a couple of minutes
p: Select photos and videos and the app edits the reel for you: it picks pacing, transitions, motion and color to suit your footage and enhances every clip. Add a title and choose an aspect ratio: 9:16, 16:9, 1:1, 4:5 or 3:4. Animating photos in auto-edit is part of Pro.

sections.h2: What else the editor can do
ul: Text to speech: AI voices and real voice actors, up to 3000 characters.
Auto subtitles: recognizes speech in video and audio tracks and times the captions precisely; show 1, 2 or 3 words or a whole phrase and fix any line.
Voice cleanup: removes noise, wind and music and keeps the voice.
Auto enhance: brightness, color and white balance in one tap.
Photo resize: ready sizes for Google Play (banner, icon, screenshot), Instagram, YouTube or custom.
Saved projects, undo and redo, and export of the finished video.

p: For anyone making short videos for Reels, TikTok, Shorts or ads, running a blog or promoting a business who wants a neat video quickly without a computer. The author makes ad videos for his own apps in Frame AI, such as [PHONE DETOX](app:phone-detox) and [MOMENT NOW](app:moment-now).

You can install the app and use the editor for free. AI video generation and voiceover use credits, and some features, like animating photos in auto-edit, are part of Frame AI Pro. Projects sync with your account; media stays on your device.

ol: Install Frame AI from Google Play and choose your language.
Tap New project or pick AI video, auto-edit, voiceover or subtitles.
Add photos or videos, adjust the result and tap Export.

faq.q: How do I turn a photo into a video?
faq.a: Open AI video, choose a photo and describe the motion. Frame AI creates an 8-second video with sound in 9:16 or 16:9.
The app and the basic editor are free. AI video and voiceover use credits, and some features are part of Pro.
